desc:
🌌 Start as a tiny Dust Cloud and grow into a Black Hole!

Collect cosmic dust, buy upgrades and evolve through 7 stages: Dust Cloud → Asteroid → Moon → Planet → Gas Giant → Star → Black Hole. Every stage opens something new on your plot:

⛏️ Mining Colony: send out drones and click glowing gems
🔬 Research Lab: research that keeps going while you're away
🏛️ Civilization: lead your people from the Tribal Age to the stars
👽 Alien Contact: trade with alien ships that land on your plot
⚛️ Antimatter Reactor: power up your Black Hole

☄️ Crack meteors for cool cosmic pets
💥 Go Supernova for Stardust, permanent upgrades and special titles
🎁 Daily rewards, daily quests and offline earnings
🏆 Global leaderboards 

How big can you grow? 🌠
